title: Theo and the Radiators
author: Y. M. Dunmore
blurb: Mara Okafor, a piano tuner who hears the house's history in its radiators, has perfected the smile that ends conversations. Then a box of undelivered letters surfaces behind a wardrobe — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must forgive the stranger in the old photographs, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
